patthana21.55:1.1: pahātabbaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbo sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.55:3.1: na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na bhāvanāya pahātabbo sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.55:5.1: na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na dassanena pahātabbahetuko sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.55:7.1: na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.55:9.1: na savitakkaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avitakko sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.55:11.1: na savicāraṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca avicāro sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana21.55:13.1: sanidassanaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sappītiko sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.55:15.1: na pītisahagataṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na pītisahagato sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.55:17.1: na sukhasahagataṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sukhasahagato sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.55:19.1: na upekkhā sahagataṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na upekkhāsahagato sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.55:21.1: na kāmāvacaraṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kāmāvacaro sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.55:23.1: na rūpāvacaraṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na rūpāvacaro sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.55:25.1: na arūpāvacaraṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na arūpāvacaro sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.55:27.1: na pariyāpannaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca apariyāpanno sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.55:29.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyyāniko sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.55:31.1: na niyataṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca aniyato sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.55:33.1: na sauttaraṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sauttaro sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.55:35.1: na saraṇaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ.
patthana21.55:36.1: na araṇaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ.
patthana21.55:37.1: na saraṇaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighañca na araṇaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighañca dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.55:40.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo anidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekaṃ, adhipatiyā ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ.
patthana21.55:41.1: na saraṇaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ.
patthana21.55:42.1: na saraṇaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati ārammaṇapaccayā. tīṇi. na hetuyā ekaṃ, nārammaṇe tīṇi. na adhipatiyā tīṇi. no avigate tīṇi,
patthana21.55:46.1: na saraṇo na sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo araṇassa sanidassana sappaṭighassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo, na araṇo na sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo araṇassa sanidassana sappaṭighassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo,
patthana21.55:47.1: hetuyā dve, adhipatiyā dve, avigate dve,
patthana21.55:48.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomampi paccaniyampi anulomapaccanīyampi paccanīyānulomampi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.) paccaniyānuloma dukatika paṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
